title: DFT energy–volume curve
action: Perform DFT total-energy calculations for the cubic InNCe₃ structure (space group Pm‑3m, Wyckoff positions: In 1a (0,0,0), N 1b (0.5,0.5,0.5), Ce 3c (0,0.5,0.5)) at a range of lattice constants. Use the LSDA functional. Output a file containing the energy vs. volume data points.

title: Birch–Murnaghan EOS fit
action: Fit the E(V) data from Step 1 to the Birch–Murnaghan equation of state to obtain the equilibrium lattice constant a₀, zero‑pressure bulk modulus B₀, and pressure derivative B′. Save these equilibrium properties.

title: Elastic constants calculation
action: At the equilibrium volume, apply volume‑conserving orthorhombic and monoclinic strains, recompute DFT total energies, and extract C₁₁, C₁₂, C₄₄ from the strain–energy relations. Write the values in GPa to elastic_constants.json.
description: Zero‑pressure elastic constants of cubic InNCe₃.

title: Polycrystalline sound velocities
action: From elastic constants and density, compute polycrystalline bulk and shear moduli (Voigt–Reuss–Hill), then longitudinal, transverse, and average sound velocities. Write the results in m/s to polycrystalline_sound_velocities.json.
description: Polycrystalline sound velocities derived from elastic constants.

title: Debye temperature from elastic constants
action: Compute the Debye temperature θ_D,el from the average sound velocity, molecular mass, and number of atoms per formula unit. Write the result in K to debye_temp_from_elastic.json.
description: Debye temperature derived from elastic constants (θ_D,el).

title: Quasi‑harmonic Debye model thermodynamic properties
action: Implement the quasi‑harmonic Debye model using E(V) data and Poisson’s ratio. Minimise G*(V;P=0,T) and extract C_V at 1000 K, Debye temperature at 300 K, and thermal expansion coefficient α at 300 K. Write the results to thermodynamic_properties.json in J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹, K, and K⁻¹.
description: Key quasi‑harmonic Debye model quantities at 0 GPa.
